data.one_liner: Ping IP subnets and discover local network devices and services.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to scan an IP subnet to find active network devices and open ports. It provides stream-based network discovery methods to locate printers, services, or other hardware on a local Wi-Fi network.
use_when: You need to discover printers or smart devices on a local Wi-Fi network.
You want to scan a specific subnet and port to find active IP addresses.
avoid_when: You are communicating with remote internet APIs rather than local network hardware.
You need robust device discovery protocols like mDNS or UPnP instead of raw port pinging.
strengths: Provides stream-based discovery for monitoring found devices in real time.
Supports checking single ports or entire subnets.
Tested on both Android and iOS platforms.
weaknesses: Requires the device to be connected to Wi-Fi and relies on a separate plugin to fetch local IP info.
Raw port scanning can be slow or blocked depending on network firewalls.
data.setup_notes: Requires the wifi_info_plugin_plus dependency and appropriate local network permissions depending on the target platform.
